installation.description: The installation the backup is of, as its path in the archive bucket names it.

trigger.description: What started the run: schedule, run (a person or workload asked) or cli.

modules.description: How many modules the backup holds.

records.description: How many records the backup holds, in all sections.

chunks.description: How many sealed chunks the backup holds.

resumed.description: Whether the run continued one that had been interrupted.

object_key.description: The key of the encrypted object in the archive bucket, as the sidecar names it. Absent on a failure.

object_size.description: The size in bytes of the encrypted object. Absent on a failure.

object_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the encrypted object, lower-case hex. A restore requires the object it fetched to match it. Absent on a failure.

sidecar_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the sidecar as it was written, lower-case hex. A restore requires the sidecar it fetched to match it. Absent on a failure.

recipients.description: The SHA-256 of each age recipient (the age1... string) the backup was encrypted to, lower-case hex, sorted. A restore requires the sidecar's recipients, and the ones it is configured with, to give the same list. Absent on a failure.

reason.description: A short word for why a run failed (export, archive, key, maintenance, canceled); absent on success.
